note: One short clip per Thai word. 'scene' = the still picture (Flux), 'motion' = what happens in the clip (Wan 2.2). word_id links to data/curriculum.json for the finished video.

clips.scene: stands in front of a sparkling golden Thai temple with tiered red and gold roofs, morning sunshine, a few marigold garlands
clips.motion: the baby elephant presses its front feet together and gives a gentle bow in a Thai wai greeting, then smiles at the camera, ears flapping softly, the camera slowly pushes in

clips.scene: stands at a colourful Thai fruit market stall piled with mangoes, rambutans and pineapples, striped awnings overhead
clips.motion: the baby elephant takes a mango with its trunk, bows politely to say thank you and happily waves its trunk, gentle handheld camera

clips.scene: sits on a little stool at a Bangkok street food stall at night with a steaming bowl of noodles on the table, glowing lanterns behind
clips.motion: the baby elephant slurps noodles with its trunk, closes its eyes with delight and wiggles happily, steam rising, warm lantern light flickering

clips.scene: stands in a shallow clear pool at the bottom of a lush jungle waterfall, ferns and tropical flowers all around
clips.motion: the baby elephant sucks up water with its trunk and sprays it into the air, sparkling droplets, it laughs and splashes, camera slowly circles

clips.scene: sits in a small wooden boat on a busy Thai floating market canal, boats full of fruit and flowers, wooden houses on stilts
clips.motion: the boat glides gently along the canal, the baby elephant looks around excitedly and waves its trunk at the other boats, water rippling

clips.scene: looks out of the open window of a small vintage Thai train passing bright green rice fields and palm trees
clips.motion: the train moves along, the baby elephant leans out of the window with ears flapping in the wind, rice fields rush past, happy expression

clips.scene: walks along a village path holding a big banana leaf over its head with its trunk like an umbrella during warm tropical rain
clips.motion: rain falls, the baby elephant walks forward happily under its banana leaf, stops to stamp in a puddle with a splash, camera tracks beside it

clips.scene: stands on a white sand Thai beach with turquoise sea, limestone cliffs and a longtail boat, bright hot sun
clips.motion: the baby elephant fans itself with its big ears, wipes its brow with its trunk, then runs happily into the gentle waves, heat shimmer in the air

clips.scene: stands beside a basket of tropical fruits including a spiky durian, mangoes and dragon fruit, at a sunny roadside stall
clips.motion: the baby elephant sniffs the durian with its trunk, makes a funny surprised face, then happily picks up a mango instead, playful comedy timing

clips.scene: stands by a river at night during a Thai lantern festival, floating krathong flower boats with candles on the water and paper lanterns in the sky
clips.motion: the baby elephant does a happy little dance, swaying and clapping its front feet, lanterns rising slowly into the night sky, candles twinkling

clips.scene: sits at a little table with a plate of som tam papaya salad and red chillies, at a cheerful Thai street restaurant
clips.motion: the baby elephant takes a bite, its cheeks turn bright red, it fans its mouth with its trunk and a little puff of steam comes out of its ears, funny cartoon reaction

clips.scene: rides in the back of a colourful Thai tuk-tuk on a lively Bangkok street with signs and street lights
clips.motion: the tuk-tuk zooms along the street, the baby elephant holds on and grins with ears flapping in the wind, city lights streaking past
